tools.name: ocr
tools.description: Reads an image's text and word boxes (Tesseract txt, TSV, hOCR and ALTO). Price: $0.005 a call (3 free calls a day without an API key).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ocr" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Reads an image's text and word boxes (Tesseract txt, TSV, hOCR and ALTO). Price: $0.005 a call." → after: "Reads an image's text and word boxes (Tesseract txt, TSV, hOCR and ALTO). Price: $0.005 a call (3 free calls a day without an API key)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
